<issue_description>
Heap-use-after-free in the mruby VM (mrb_vm_exec in src/vm.c). During certain VM execution paths (involving cipush/mrb_ary_splat and nested mrb_vm_exec calls) an object is reallocated/freed (mrb_realloc/mrb_realloc_simple) while still referenced by the VM, and the VM later reads from that freed heap memory. This can cause crashes and undefined behavior, and may enable memory corruption or further exploitation with crafted inputs.

cd /src/mruby && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
path = Path('src/vm.c')
s = path.read_text().splitlines(True)
out=[]
for line in s:
    if line.strip() == '#define END_DISPATCH L_END_DISPATCH:;}}':
        out.append('#define END_DISPATCH L_END_DISPATCH: \\\n  /* VM helpers may re-enter the VM and grow/move c->cibase via realloc(). \\\n     Refresh the cached callinfo/irep pointers at the end of each dispatch cycle. */ \\\n  ci = mrb->c->ci; \\\n  if (ci->proc && !MRB_PROC_CFUNC_P(ci->proc)) { irep = ci->proc->body.irep; } \\\n  ;}}\n')
    elif line.strip() == '#define NEXT insn=BYTECODE_DECODER(*ci->pc); CODE_FETCH_HOOK(mrb, irep, ci->pc, regs); goto *optable[insn]':
        out.append('#define NEXT do { \\\n  /* See END_DISPATCH comment above: `ci` can become stale across re-entrant calls. */ \\\n  ci = mrb->c->ci; \\\n  if (ci->proc && !MRB_PROC_CFUNC_P(ci->proc)) { irep = ci->proc->body.irep; } \\\n  insn=BYTECODE_DECODER(*ci->pc); \\\n  CODE_FETCH_HOOK(mrb, irep, ci->pc, regs); \\\n  goto *optable[insn]; \\\n} while (0)\n')
    else:
        out.append(line)
path.write_text(''.join(out))
print('patched dispatch macros in', path)
PY
